trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum, and it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all yours, so there is nothing separate to hunt. Use the roadmap in this guide as your route: story first, missables and stranger strands next, then collectibles, activities and the 100% completion push. If the platinum does not pop, check the tracker for a counter trophy sitting just below its target.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through Gone Fishing, the opening mission that introduces the coast of Leonida and the game's basic movement, driving and boating. It is unmissable story progress, so simply follow the objective markers and finish the mission to earn it. Take the chance to learn the controls, because everything later builds on them.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and this pops as the chapter closes. Chapter missions are marked on the map for whichever protagonist is active, and none of them can be skipped or failed permanently — a failed attempt just restarts from a checkpoint. No side content is required, so push the story forward whenever you are ready.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2, which opens up more of Vice City and its surrounding keys as the story's money troubles deepen. Keep following the chapter markers and finish the closing mission to earn the trophy. If a mission gives you trouble, stock up on armour and snacks beforehand rather than lowering your guard mid-fight.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 to earn this one. By now both protagonists' routines are established, so expect missions to swap between them and to lean on driving across the city. Nothing here is missable: chapter trophies are awarded purely for seeing the story through, in order, at your own pace.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the endgame sequence. The missions grow longer and more combat-heavy, so bring upgraded weapons and a fast car you are comfortable with. As with the other chapters, the trophy lands automatically when the chapter's final mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission to close out the campaign and earn this gold trophy. Before starting it, spend your cash on anything you still want, max out both characters' supplies, and save in a separate slot so you can return to the open world afterwards. The trophy pops as the finale concludes, whichever way it plays out.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears on the map during the early story. It is a short, self-contained job, so just follow the objectives from start to finish. Because it is a named story mission it cannot be missed — it stays available until you play it as the chapter unfolds.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, the story's big set-piece robbery. Prepare like a classic heist: pick your approach when offered, keep your wanted level in mind during the escape, and use your partner's abilities to thin out pursuers. The trophy is awarded for completing the mission, not for a clean getaway, so survive first and finesse later.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play as part of the story. Follow the markers and see the mission through to its end; there are no optional objectives tied to the trophy. If it involves protecting someone, stay close to them and clear enemies before advancing rather than rushing ahead.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a story mission centred on Vice City's nightlife scene. Play it when its marker appears and finish every objective in sequence. Like all named story missions it is required progression, so it cannot be locked away — finish the mission and the trophy is yours.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown, the story mission that brings you into conflict with the airport authority at Vice City International. Expect a heavy police response, so plan your exit route before the shooting starts. Completing the mission earns the trophy regardless of how messy the escape gets — and while you are around VCIA, keep the missable Catch Me If You Can in mind.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a late-story, military-flavoured operation. It is one of the most combat-dense missions in the game, so lean on cover, Combat Focus and your partner's covering fire, and do not be shy about using heavy weapons. The trophy pops when the operation wraps up.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% game completion, tracked on the stats page: story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities, races, ranges and world exploration all feed the percentage. Work through the other stages of this roadmap first, because nearly everything they cover counts towards the total. Save this gold for last and use the in-game checklist to find whatever final few percent are hiding.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunt moves — jumps, near misses, wheelies, stoppies and other feats the game logs as stunts — anywhere in Leonida. Stunts register during normal driving, so the counter climbs fastest on a motorcycle or in a nimble sports car, chaining jumps around the city and the stunt ramps scattered across the state. Check your running total in the stats menu and grind the last few at your favourite ramp.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's 9 activity types at least once: races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation and drone events each count as a type. You do not need to win or even finish them — starting each type once is enough — so spend an afternoon sampling the icons on the map. The trophy pops when the last untouched type has been tried.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges spread across Leonida's gun stores and ranges. Each challenge scores accuracy and speed, so learn a weapon's recoil on the easier ranges first, then work up; medals are saved per challenge, so you can gold them in any order and retry instantly. A high-accuracy pistol or rifle makes the later golds far less painful.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations around the state. Finishing is not enough — you need first place at each track — so learn each course's line with a practice run, then race it cleanly and cut corners where the checkpoints allow. Locations you have already won are marked, so tour the map and mop up the rest.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — replays of the same race do not add to the total, so keep moving to fresh race markers around Leonida. Bring a tuned car in the right class for each event and prioritise clean lines over aggression, since one crash usually costs more time than a rival does. The trophy lands on your twentieth distinct victory.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in one of his fishing challenges. Find Cal at his fishing spots, accept the challenge, and land the heavier or rarer catch before the timer ends — better bait and a patient hand on the reeling tension win these. If you lose, he will happily run it back, so retry until your catch beats his.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game, start to finish, at the arcades and bars around Vice City. Pick the shortest cabinet you can find, learn its pattern, and see it through to its ending screen rather than quitting at game over. Only one full completion is needed, so this is a quick detour between missions.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand by completing his final mission. Work through each of Andy's map markers as they appear — strands unlock in sequence, and the finale only shows once the earlier jobs are done. These side stories stay available after the campaign, so if you missed him during the story, sweep his icons up during cleanup.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission to close out his strand. Follow his sequence of jobs from the first marker to the last; the final mission is the one that resolves his story and awards the trophy. Stranger strands are never permanently missable, so work through them at your leisure after the credits if you prefer.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand by completing his final mission. Billy's jobs appear one at a time on the map, and each completed job unlocks the next until the finale. Keep an eye out for his marker after finishing the story if it has not appeared — some strands only advance once earlier ones are underway.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and the other odd souls marked on your map. A strand only counts when its final mission is done, so finish what you start rather than sampling first jobs. Any 8 strands will do, and the individual strand trophies in this guide cover most of them.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission to finish his strand. Randy's work is a chain of jobs that unlock in order, so keep returning to his marker until the finale appears. As with all stranger content, it waits patiently on the map — nothing about it expires when the story ends.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand by completing his final mission. Play through his sequence of jobs as they surface on the map; the last one pays out the trophy. If his marker seems to vanish, progress another strand or a story mission and check the map again — strands often gate behind game progress.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots scattered across Leonida — quiet overlooks, beaches and hilltops you discover as you explore. Sit through the short meditation at each spot for it to register, and combine the tour with exploring the map for The Goodtime State. A helicopter or a fast car makes the full circuit much quicker.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after and bring the hunt to a successful end. Follow Bret's lead to the animal's territory, track it using the on-screen cues, and make the kill cleanly when it shows itself. Unique animals only appear for this job, so if it escapes, re-approach the area and the trail will reset.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden all over Leonida — on benches, counters, rooftops and piers — and each belongs to a themed set shown in the collectibles menu. Focus on finishing the three shortest sets first rather than scattering pickups across all of them, and sweep an area thoroughly before moving on, because single missing cards are the usual blocker.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It photo spot at 100 locations across the state. These spots are viewpoints and landmarks; when you are near one, the prompt appears — stop, snap it, and move on. They are dense in Vice City itself, so a methodical sweep of the city plus a lap of the keys and the northern shore gets most of the hundred without backtracking.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's Challenges — the short scored tasks tracked in the challenges menu, covering driving, combat, exploration and activities. Most complete themselves as you play the rest of this roadmap, so check the menu late in your run and deliberately finish whichever categories are lagging. Retrying a failed challenge is instant, so none of the 50 needs to be feared.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level and then lose the heat completely without being busted or wasted. Commit crimes together until the fourth star lights, then break line of sight, swap vehicles and hide somewhere quiet — alleys, car parks and the mangroves all work — until the stars drain away. Both characters must still be together when the level clears.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping a Wanted Level alive the whole time. Plan a tight triangle of stores, drive straight between them, and do not let the stars fully expire between robberies — if the heat is about to die, start the next robbery before it does. Keep the engine running and your partner close; a busted or wasted character ends the streak.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — a vehicle counts the first time you get in and drive it. Traffic variety differs by district, so tour rich neighbourhoods, industrial yards, marinas and the airport, and hop into anything you do not recognise, including boats and bikes. Your discovered list lives in the stats menu; the last few are usually rare sports cars that only spawn in wealthy areas.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single activation of Combat Focus. Build the meter first, then trigger it in a crowd — a gang operation, a police standoff or a busy mission firefight — and prioritise headshots while time is slowed. If a use ends at four, do not waste the next one on stragglers: wait for another packed fight and try again.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA — Vice City International Airport — by getting airborne in an aircraft outside any scripted sequence: breach the airfield in free roam, take a parked plane and lift off. Do it while the airport is open to you around the VCIA Takedown story beat, because the opportunity is tied to that part of the game. Check the airfield early rather than assuming it will still be there in a late cleanup sweep.
trophies.missable_note: Tied to the VCIA airport sequence around the VCIA Takedown mission — take your unscheduled flight while that area is active in the story, and verify the airfield is still accessible before leaving it for endgame cleanup.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with a Rhino — the army tank that rolls out at the highest Wanted Levels and around military ground. The description is deliberately cryptic, so cover both readings: raise hell until the military responds, then either hijack a Rhino when its crew is exposed, or destroy one with sticky explosives and heavy fire. One of those two interactions is what the trophy is watching for, and either way, constant movement keeps you alive long enough to do it.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Case the store first, enter quietly, and avoid tripping alarms or filling the awareness of guards and cameras during the grab and the exit. If anyone's suspicion meter fills, abandon the attempt and try another store — a clean, unseen robbery is the whole requirement.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Successfully rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape the police afterwards. Vault jobs are the heavy end of free-roam crime: bring your partner, heavy weapons and a fast, durable getaway car parked facing out. Crack the vault, grab the money and lose the heat — a robbery you are busted during does not count, so survival beats greed on the fifth run as much as the first.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away clean. Armored trucks appear on the move around the state; the classic play is to stop the truck, blast the rear doors open with explosives or sustained fire, grab the cash and vanish before the response escalates. Have your escape car ready before you open the doors — on this one, the timer is the police, not the truck.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 named areas of Leonida so the whole state is revealed and visited. Most areas register just by passing through, so a full road trip — Vice City's districts, the keys, the port, the swamps and the northern towns — covers nearly everything. Check the map for greyed pockets at the end; the stragglers are usually small islands and industrial corners reachable only by boat.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Gang operations surface as you explore and stir up trouble, and each gang's turf has its own flavour of business to hit. Keep a note of which gangs you have already robbed — the trophy needs one operation from every gang, not nine robberies total — and hunt the missing colours in their home districts.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, Vice City's beachfront strip. Head to one of the beachfront bars or hotel terraces along the Ocean Beach shore, order a drink, and enjoy the moment the way the game intends — a deliberate echo of where this city's story began. It takes a minute and costs a few dollars; do it at sunset for the full effect.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom through its glass frontage in a car, in classic style. Vehicle showrooms sit in Vice City's wealthier districts: take a car from inside or on display, line up with the windows, and drive straight through them onto the street. If a story set-piece puts you in a showroom earlier, take the dramatic exit then — otherwise the free-roam showrooms work at any time.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — and, as the description hints, mind your follow-through on the throw. Walk in, start a game at the lanes and play it through; the trophy is tied to bowling there rather than to winning, so a full game with honest throws is the safe route. It only takes a few minutes between bigger jobs.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This one tracks your partnership reaching a moment of mass appeal — a shared high point for the duo that the game measures quietly as you play together. Use both protagonists rather than favouring one, and take part in the paired content the game offers: shared missions, robberies, races and escapes. It tends to pop naturally during a thorough playthrough, so if it is still missing late, spend time on partner activities instead of solo grinding.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 tracked choices — the dialogue picks, mission decisions and small moral calls the game quietly counts as you play, as PlayStation's counter shows. There is no menu of choices to farm: simply play thoroughly, engage with optional conversations and side content instead of skipping them, and the total climbs on its own. A full story-plus-cleanup run should carry you most of the way there.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed at something on your second attempt, right after failing it once — the trophy rewards a comeback, not perfection. The natural place is a repeatable scored activity: fail a race, a range challenge or a stunt attempt, immediately retry it, and win. Because it needs a genuine failure followed by success, do not go out of your way early; it will almost certainly happen by accident while you chase the activity trophies.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness one of Leonida's strange happenings — the unexplained lights, odd figures and other weird encounters the state hides off the beaten path, usually at night and away from the city. When something bizarre starts, stay and watch it play out rather than driving off; the trophy is for witnessing, not intervening. Swamps, the keys and remote beaches after midnight are the classic hunting grounds for this kind of thing.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a person down with a melee drive-by — strike someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl them over. Equip a melee weapon as your drive-by weapon, find a lone pedestrian somewhere quiet, and swing as you pass at moderate speed: too slow and you only nudge them, too fast and you run them down instead. A motorcycle gives you the cleanest swing.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and scores; instead of sitting on them, pass them through the laundering contacts the game introduces and let clean money come back. Choose the laundering option whenever you are holding marked cash and the total accumulates across the whole playthrough — big vault and heist scores move it fastest.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in the game — clothes, weapons, vehicles, food and services all count, as long as money leaves your pocket at a till. This accumulates naturally if you buy outfits, guns and upgrades instead of hoarding cash. If you are short late in the run, a shopping spree through Vice City's luxury stores finishes it in minutes.
trophies.sources: Official trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles. Strategy: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties available across Leonida. Garages appear as property markers once you can afford to buy; purchase each one outright when its marker shows. Fund them from heists and robberies rather than spending everything on cars — the full set is a serious investment, and earning for it pairs naturally with Treat Yo Self and Dime on the Dollar along the way.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you get into a new vehicle, use the app's registration option to log it to your collection — a different vehicle each time, since duplicates do not add to the count. Ten registrations is quick work if you make it a habit every time you steal something new during the Whip It Good vehicle hunt.

roadmap.title: Story Playthrough — Welcome to Leonida
roadmap.advice: Play the campaign from Gone Fishing to the finale, swapping between both protagonists as the chapters demand. Do not chase collectibles yet — almost everything stays on the map — but keep one eye on Vice City International Airport: the missable Catch Me If You Can is tied to the VCIA Takedown part of the story. Save in a separate slot before the final mission so the open world is exactly as you left it afterwards.

roadmap.title: Missables & Stranger Cleanup
roadmap.advice: First, if you have not already, take your unscheduled flight out of VCIA while that sequence is still fresh. Then work the stranger markers: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret each run a chain of jobs that only counts when the final mission is done, and finishing any eight strands earns Strangers & Freaks. Strands never expire, so this stage is relaxed — but it feeds both the trophy count and your completion percentage.

roadmap.title: Collectibles — Cards, Cameras & Cars
roadmap.advice: Sweep Leonida district by district instead of criss-crossing the map. Finish the three shortest Collectible Card sets, snap WAiNK It spots whenever the prompt appears (they are densest in Vice City), and get into every unfamiliar vehicle you see — discoveries feed Whip It Good while registrations feed On the Spot. A single organised lap of the state clears most of this stage.

roadmap.title: Activities & the Open World
roadmap.advice: Start by sampling every activity type once for Master of None, then go for the scored clears: Shooting Range golds, Top Fun wins at all 14 locations and 20 different race victories. After that, turn to the open-world feats — partner robberies, bank vaults, gang operations, the money trophies and full exploration of all 52 areas. Almost everything here also pushes your completion percentage, so this is the longest but most rewarding stage.

roadmap.title: The Final Percent — 100% & the Platinum
roadmap.advice: Open the stats page and hunt the last missing percent: an unfinished strand, a handful of challenges or one grey corner of the map is the usual culprit. When A Long Road lands at 100%, the platinum — Vice Got a Price! — follows automatically once every other trophy is earned. There are no online trophies on this list, so nothing here needs another player.
